blocks.text: - In general, do not instill antihistamine eye drops immediately before or during flight/safety related duties. It is common to develop temporary blurred vision each time the drops are applied.
blocks.html: • In general, do not instill antihistamine eye drops immediately before or during flight/safety related duties. It is common to develop temporary blurred vision each time the drops are applied.

blocks.text: - Pilocarpine (Vuity) is a prescription eye drop used for presbyopia (age-related, blurry near vision). It creates a temporary chemical correction of visual acuity by decreasing pupil size. This can increase depth of focus and give transient improvement to near vision in individuals with presbyopia. There are overt FDA-required warnings from the manufacturer regarding night vision and operating machinery. Since medication and the availability of ambient lighting impact visual acuity, pilocarpine is unacceptable.
